  - region "Meet the Babys":
    - text: The original six
    - heading "Meet the Babys" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Every flame has a role. Every flame has an attitude.
    - article:
      - img "Ruko, an orange-red round flame brawler with a flame mohawk, sporty headband, and captain's grin"
      - heading "RUKO" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Leader
      - text: Brawler Fist Flurry
      - paragraph: “Heads up, flames up — we win together!”
      - text: Attitude
      - paragraph: The locker-room spark plug. Ruko calls the plays, lifts the squad, and charges in first so nobody has to fight alone.
      - text: Extra attributes Power 9 Speed 8 Teamwork 10 Backstory
      - paragraph: Ruko sparked to life beside the old Ember Dash training track and raced every flame who rolled past. When a rookie squad got lost in the ash fields, he coached them home one brave step at a time—and earned the captain’s headband.
    - article:
      - img "Blaze, a golden round flame hero wearing a small star crown and heroic grin"
      - heading "BLAZE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Star-Crowned
      - text: Hero · Your avatar Fire Nova
      - paragraph: “Follow me. Try to keep up.”
      - text: Attitude
      - paragraph: Fearless, bright, and built for the big moment. Blaze trusts a bold plan, a loyal crew, and one perfectly timed Fire Nova.
      - text: Extra attributes Power 9 Bravery 10 Focus 8 Backstory
      - paragraph: A tiny fallen star landed in the castle furnace and woke up as Blaze. The star crown chose Blaze to carry its light, but being a hero still means earning the squad’s trust in every battle.
    - article:
      - img "Boulder, a deep magma-red round flame guardian with soft eyes and rocky shoulder plates"
      - heading "BOULDER" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Gentle Wall
      - text: Guardian Magma Taunt
      - paragraph: “Nobody touches my friends. NOBODY.”
      - text: Attitude
      - paragraph: "A mountain-sized softie with an unbreakable promise: everybody gets home. Boulder would rather share a warm snack—but threaten a friend and the wall goes up."
      - text: Extra attributes Toughness 10 Kindness 10 Speed 4 Backstory
      - paragraph: Boulder began as a quiet lump of cooling lava beneath the castle bridge. When a storm trapped three little sparks outside, the rock cracked open, stood tall, and sheltered them until morning.
    - article:
      - img "Sizzle, a bright yellow-pink round flame archer with a flowing ponytail, playful wink, and bow"
      - heading "SIZZLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Showoff
      - text: Girl Archer Spark Volley
      - paragraph: “Watch and learn, boys.”
      - text: Attitude
      - paragraph: If there’s a spotlight, Sizzle already found it. She turns impossible shots into a performance, takes a bow, and somehow lands the next arrow without looking.
      - text: Extra attributes Speed 9 Aim 10 Style 10 Backstory
      - paragraph: Sizzle learned archery by firing sparks through rings of steam at the Sunflare Fair. One perfect trick shot saved the grand finale, and she has treated every battlefield like center stage ever since.
    - article:
      - img "Cinder, a violet-red round flame pyro with twin ember buns and a mischievous grin"
      - heading "CINDER" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Chaos Gremlin
      - text: Girl Pyro Meteor Drop
      - paragraph: “Hehehe... did that explode? GOOD.”
      - text: Attitude
      - paragraph: Curious, giggly, and always one button away from trouble. Cinder means well—she just thinks every plan can be improved with a surprise from the sky.
      - text: Extra attributes Power 8 Mischief 10 Control 5 Backstory
      - paragraph: Cinder’s first sneeze dropped a pebble-sized meteor into the practice yard. Instead of hiding, she spent years learning to aim the chaos—mostly in the right direction.
    - article:
      - img "Lord Inferno, a dark crimson-black round flame villain with a jagged black-fire crown and menacing grin"
      - heading "LORD INFERNO" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The Wildfire King
      - text: Boss · Villain Cataclysm Slam
      - paragraph: “Little flames. BOW.”
      - text: Attitude
      - paragraph: Loud, ruthless, and certain the whole realm belongs to him. Lord Inferno never asks—he commands, crushes, and cackles from behind his black-fire crown.
      - text: Extra attributes Power 10 Cunning 9 Mercy 1 Backstory
      - paragraph: Lord Inferno rose from a forbidden furnace buried under the Scorched Crown. He decided every flame should serve him, seized a fortress, and now sends his army to darken every free spark in the realm.
